footer.about: Custom shirts, hoodies, hats, banners, business cards and stickers, printed in Elgin, Illinois.

steps.title: Send your idea
steps.body: Upload a file, send a photo or describe it. We take JPG, PNG, PDF, AI, EPS, PSD and SVG.

steps.title: Approve the proof
steps.body: We send a digital proof. Nothing prints until you say yes.

steps.title: We print and check it
steps.body: We print your order and check its quality before it leaves the shop.

steps.title: Pick up or ship
steps.body: Most orders are ready 24–48 hours after approval. Pick up in Elgin, get local delivery or ship nationwide.
